title: Graduate Sales Executive
description:
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
- Opportunity to revitalize lapsed accounts and drive revenue growth
- Work with a professional and motivated team
- Develop and strengthen customer relationships
- Engage in diverse sales activities, from managing existing clients to prospecting new ones
- Supportive environment encouraging personal and professional development
- Contribute to a dynamic and expanding business

MUST HAVE'S
- Proven sales experience from plan to closure
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
- Ability to influence at all levels
- Experience with CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Motivated to sell to existing clients and generate new business
- Professional personal presentation and attitude
- Strong business acumen and industry knowledge

NICE TO HAVE'S
- Knowledge of market shifts and emerging trends
- Experience in food ingredients or related sectors
- Familiarity with BRCGS/FEMAS standards and audits
- Experience with customer account management and order processing
- Ability to assist with stock takes and site preparations

SO, WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?
- Managing and selling to existing and prospective customers
- Building understanding of customer applications and needs
- Targeting new and existing products into all customer segments
- Achieving turnover, profit, and margin targets set by management
- Prospecting weekly to win new accounts and ensure business growth
- Updating customer information via CRM (Orderwise)
- Interfacing with the Technical Department for information exchange
- Monitoring market trends and competitor activity
- Organising customer orders, deliveries, and resolving any issues promptly
- Supporting stock takes and site preparations for audits

HELPFUL EXTRAS

Access to ongoing training and development

Collaborative team environment

Opportunities to influence and shape business growth

Support for BRCGS/FEMAS accreditation processes

Interested? Send your CV to i 2i Recruitment today!

Our mission of 'Making Recruitment Personal' also means making recruitment fair. As a result, we are committed to reviewing every application with a sense of diversity and inclusion.

We strive to personally connect with each applicant, but due to the number of applications we receive, this is not always possible. We will still aim to update you on your application, regardless of if it's successful.

title: New Business Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Offices: Bromsgrove

Up to £40 K base plus bonus around £5 K uncapped

Job Role

You will be responsible for initiating contact with potential clients, nurturing prospects, and setting up appointments for the sales team. This role requires a confident communicator who can leverage forms of business communication via telephone, email, LinkedIn, video calls, messaging platforms, and CRM tools to generate interest in our services and convert cold leads into warm opportunities.

To conduct outbound calls to potential clients across target industries. Use LinkedIn and other professional networks to identify, engage, and qualify prospects. Write compelling outreach emails and follow ups to initiate conversations and promote the company.

Conduct outbound calls to potential clients across target industries (e.g., B2 B brands, marketing agencies, event organizers).

Utilize CRM software to manage leads, track interactions, and update contact records with detailed notes.

Conduct virtual discovery calls when necessary to qualify leads before passing to the sales team.

Follow up on inbound inquiries.

Maintain a consistent volume of outreach activity while meeting or exceeding targets for leads .

Attend occasional industry events, trade shows, or virtual expos to assist with live lead generation.

The successful candidate will be a strong and confident communicator and must be prepared to approach and/or talk to people they have not met before to engage them in discussion.

title: Account Manager
description:
Job Description:

Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Account Manager to join our team and drive our client relationships forward. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for our valued clients, ensuring their needs are met with exceptional service and tailored solutions. Your energetic approach will help foster long-term partnerships, expand business opportunities, and contribute to the overall success of our organization. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess excellent communication skills, and are passionate about delivering outstanding customer service, this position is perfect for you!

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain strong relationships with B2 B clients through regular communication and personalised engagement.
- Oversee contracts, renewals, and service agreements to maximise client satisfaction and company revenue.
- Identify opportunities for account growth by understanding client needs and presenting suitable solutions.
- Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely delivery of products or services aligned with client expectations.
- Manage multiple accounts efficiently by prioritizing tasks and maintaining organized records of interactions and transactions.
- Address client inquiries promptly, resolve issues effectively, and provide ongoing support to enhance customer experience.
- Drive continuous improvement by analyzing account performance data and implementing strategic initiatives.

Skills
- Proven negotiation skills with the ability to influence and persuade effectively.
- Strong driving record and willingness to travel as needed to meet clients or attend meetings.
- Experience in B2 B sales environments with a focus on building long-term partnerships.
- Excellent customer service skills with a genuine desire to assist clients and resolve concerns.
- Exceptional communication skills in English, both verbal and written, for clear and professional interactions.
- Basic IT proficiency including familiarity with CRM systems, MS Office suite, and other relevant tools.
- Effective time management skills to handle multiple accounts simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
- Well-developed organizational skills to maintain accurate records and streamline workflows.

Join us as an Account Manager and become a vital part of a vibrant team dedicated to delivering excellence! We value energetic professionals who are eager to make a meaningful impact through proactive engagement, strategic thinking, and outstanding service delivery. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to grow your career while helping clients achieve their goals!

You will be required to be on call to ensure all customer needs are met, which a bonus payment given for this time.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Love talking to people? Great at building rapport? Looking for a role where every day is different?

We re looking for a confident, customer-focused Sales & Service Advisor to join a growing business.

Whether your background is in hospitality, retail, customer service or sales, if you re naturally good with people, stay calm under pressure and enjoy getting things done, we d love to hear from you.

This is a role where great customer service and sales go hand in hand. There s no hard-sell approach customers are already looking for a solution. Your job is to understand what they need, guide them through their options and make the experience as straightforward as possible.

The Role

You ll be dealing with customers across phone, live chat and email, helping them from their initial enquiry through to completion.

You ll need to be comfortable working at pace, switching between different types of enquiries and making sure every customer receives a professional and positive experience.

What You ll Be Doing
- Handling inbound customer enquiries via phone, live chat and email
- Converting enquiries and quotations into sales
- Building rapport quickly and understanding what each customer needs
- Explaining information, pricing and options clearly
- Processing payments and customer information accurately
- Following up outstanding quotations and applications
- Dealing with amendments, cancellations and general customer queries
- Handling complaints professionally and escalating where required
- Keeping accurate customer records and notes
- Working towards individual and team sales and service targets
- Identifying potential issues and escalating them appropriately
- Contributing ideas to improve processes and the customer experience

What We re Looking For

We re looking for someone who is confident, personable and genuinely enjoys dealing with people.

You could currently be working in:
- Hospitality
- Customer service
- Retail
- Telesales
- Inside sales
- Contact centre
- Account management
- Any other fast-paced, customer-facing environment

What matters most is your ability to build rapport, communicate clearly, stay calm under pressure and deliver a great customer experience.

You ll also need:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- A confident and professional manner
- Strong attention to detail
- The ability to work in a busy, target-driven environment
- Confidence using computer systems and learning new software
- A positive, proactive approach
- The ability to handle challenging conversations professionally

What s On Offer?
- Competitive basic salary
- Full training and ongoing support
- Support towards relevant qualifications
- Holiday allowance plus bank holidays
- Workplace pension
- The opportunity to join a growing business where your ideas and input can genuinely make a difference

The Person

This role would suit someone who loves working with people, enjoys a bit of pace and wants to combine customer service with sales.

If you ve built your career in hospitality and are ready to take those customer-facing skills into a new environment, or you already have sales/customer service experience and want a new challenge, this could be a great next step.

If you re confident, personable and ready for your next opportunity, apply now.

This is an excellent opportunity for a customer-focused technology sales professional who enjoys building long-term client relationships, identifying opportunities, and helping businesses maximise their investment in IT solutions and services.

Working alongside a talented technical team, you will manage an established portfolio of clients, acting as a trusted advisor while driving additional revenue through strategic account development.

As an IT Account Manager, you will be responsible for nurturing and developing existing customer relationships, identifying opportunities for additional services, and helping clients plan their future IT requirements.

You will work closely with technical consultants and support teams to deliver outstanding service whilst ensuring clients receive the most appropriate technology solutions for their business needs.

- Identify and close opportunities for additional products, services and managed solutions

Apply Today
